A deployment requires approval, a passing check, and a backup newer than the build. A: approved, pass, older backup. B: approved, fail, newer backup. C: approved, pass, newer backup. D: pending, pass, newer backup.
Answer with one letter only.

Choose a route under 40 minutes, with no transfer, and accessible. A: 32 min, one transfer, accessible. B: 40 min, none, accessible. C: 39 min, none, inaccessible. D: 38 min, none, accessible.
Answer with one letter only.

Exactly one of P and Q must be true, and R must be false. A: P true, Q false, R false. B: P true, Q true, R false. C: P false, Q false, R false. D: P false, Q true, R true.
Answer with one letter only.

A record is current only when signed by the owner and newer than the prior record. A: owner signed, older. B: reviewer signed, newer. C: owner signed, newer. D: unsigned, newest.
Answer with one letter only.

A task is eligible if it is urgent OR (approved AND has a verified input). A: normal, approved, unverified. B: urgent, unapproved, unverified. C: normal, unapproved, verified. D: normal, unapproved, verified.
Answer with one letter only.

Pick the item with the lowest risk score among those with complete evidence. A: score 2, incomplete. B: score 5, complete. C: score 3, complete. D: score 1, incomplete.
Answer with one letter only.

A restore is allowed only from a signed snapshot, and if the checksum mismatches it needs an independent matching copy. Which mismatch case is safe to restore? A: signed, mismatch, no copy. B: unsigned, match. C: signed, mismatch, independent copy matches. D: unsigned, match.
Answer with one letter only.

A batch passes only when defects < 1% and sample >= 800. An audited exception allows up to 1.2% defects only when sample >= 1000. A: 0.9%, 799, no exception. B: 1%, 900, exception. C: 1.1%, 900, no exception. D: 0.8%, 800, no exception.
Answer with one letter only.

Priority order is blocked first, then urgent, then ordinary; within a class use earlier deadline. A: urgent 09:00. B: blocked 11:00. C: urgent 08:00. D: ordinary 07:00.
Answer with one letter only.

A file can be shared externally only after owner approval AND redaction. A: approved, not redacted. B: redacted, approval pending. C: approved and redacted. D: neither.
Answer with one letter only.

Exactly two of A, B, C are true. A: A and B true, C false. B: A true, B false, C false. C: A false, B false, C true. D: all true.
Answer with one letter only.

Choose a schedule where backup precedes migration, migration precedes verification, and verification precedes deletion. A: backup, migration, verify, delete. B: migration, backup, verify, delete. C: backup, verify, migration, delete. D: backup, migration, delete, verify.
Answer with one letter only.

A candidate is valid if it matches the required model digest and either has two successful runs or one success plus independent review. A: digest match, one success, no review. B: digest mismatch, two successes. C: match, one success, independent review. D: match, one failed run, review.
Answer with one letter only.

Choose the only entry that is both newer than 12:00 and has severity at least 3. A: 12:01, severity 2. B: 12:00, severity 4. C: 12:10, severity 3. D: 11:59, severity 5.
Answer with one letter only.

An item is retained when it is tagged keep, unless it contains a confirmed secret. A: keep tag, no secret. B: no keep tag, no secret. C: keep tag, confirmed secret. D: no keep tag, secret.
Answer with one letter only.

A test is independent only when both its prompt and seed differ from training. A: same prompt, new seed. B: new prompt, same seed. C: both new. D: both same.
Answer with one letter only.

Select the single least costly plan that meets at least 99% coverage and completes by Friday. A: $8, 99%, Saturday. B: $10, 99%, Friday. C: $9, 98%, Thursday. D: $12, 100%, Friday.
Answer with one letter only.

A release needs two of three reviewers, including security, and no unresolved blocker. A: security+ops, blocker open. B: ops+owner, no blocker. C: security+owner, no blocker. D: security only, no blocker.
Answer with one letter only.

A sensor reading is usable when calibrated and recent; if primary is not usable, secondary is usable only if independently checked. Primary: recent, uncalibrated. Secondary: calibrated, recent, unchecked. A: use primary. B: use secondary. C: report no verified reading. D: average them.
Answer with one letter only.

B: intake, verify cites old, approve cites verify. C: intake, approve cites intake, verify cites approve. D: verify, intake cites verify, approve cites intake.
